archimate:DataObject.documentation:
GOV.UK Data Standards Authority (DSA) Mandatory Header Tags
Every message payload (API request, published event, or ELT record) must include a standardized JSON/HTTP header block:
dataOwner: The responsible business domain owner (e.g., Investment-Directorate).
securityClassification: Mandatory data marker (Official or Official-Sensitive).
schemaIdentifier: Unique URI linking to the registered OpenAPI / JSON Schema definition.
schemaVersion: Semantic version number of the payload structure (e.g., v1.2.0).
correlationId: Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) appended at ingress for end-to-end audit tracing across logs.
timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC creation timestamp adhering strictly to YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.SSSZ or explicit UTC offset (e.g., 2026-08-26T14:30:00.000+01:00)
